acceptedAnswer.text: Exosomes are tiny extracellular vesicles that cells use to communicate, carrying proteins, lipids and nucleic acids that regulate biological processes. In aesthetic medicine, clinical-grade exosomes deliver regenerative signals into the skin, promoting collagen synthesis, anti-inflammatory response and cell turnover.

mainEntity.name: How is this different from PRP or PRF?

acceptedAnswer.text: PRP and PRF use your own platelets and growth factors. Exosomes are a different class of biological signal — nanovesicles produced from stem cells and processed under pharmaceutical-grade protocols. Exosomes can deliver a more concentrated and targeted regenerative effect, often used as the premium tier of regenerative facials.

We typically suggest a series of 3 sessions spaced 4 weeks apart for the initial protocol, then maintenance every 6 to 12 months. Some patients add a single exosome session as a recovery boost after intensive laser or microneedling. Ronal Perdomo Lugo, APRN, FNP-C tailors the plan to your skin objective.

hero.title: Advanced Regenerative Facial · Exosomes in Miami
hero.lede: The Advanced Regenerative Facial uses exosome technology — nanovesicles that carry regenerative signals between cells — to deliver high-grade bio-stimulation and accelerate skin renewal beyond what conventional protocols achieve.

blocks.title: What it does for you
list: Delivers regenerative signals at the cellular level through exosome technology.
Improves skin firmness, fine lines, tone and overall radiance in a measurable way.
Supports recovery after intensive procedures (laser, microneedling) by accelerating tissue repair.
Calibrated to deliver maximum regeneration with comfortable in-office time.
Performed in a controlled clinical environment with cold-chain handled exosome product.
Pairs naturally with microneedling, laser or PRF for compounded effect.
